name: ES Prior-Close Volume-Scar Handoff Diagnostic Plan v1
purpose: Falsify or qualify the mechanism without optimizing or changing the candidate.

samples.disclosure: The secondary holdout is no longer pristine and every result in this diagnostic is descriptive.

anchor_controls.prior_transaction_vwap: same prior 15:00-15:30 transactions summarized by VWAP
anchor_controls.two_session_stale_volume_scar: identical scar construction from two full RTH sessions earlier
anchor_controls.interpretation_rule: Scar specificity is supported only if the frozen scar beats all three controls in both samples. Controls cannot replace the candidate.

execution_diagnostics.adverse_tick_grid_stop: round long stops downward and short stops upward to the next 0.25-point grid after placing one tick beyond the continuous center
execution_diagnostics.delay_rule: cancel if the frozen structural stop is touched before delayed entry; otherwise enter delayed bar open plus one adverse tick
execution_diagnostics.interpretation_rule: No timing or exit control may replace the frozen candidate after results.

placebo.direction: flip every accepted signal at the same entry time with identical initial risk distance
placebo.expectation: actual direction must beat the paired flip in both samples

concentration_diagnostics: net P&L after removing top 1, 5, and 10 trades
positive week, month, and quarter fractions
five-session and twenty-session moving-block bootstrap loss probabilities before and after another 2.50 dollars per trade

portfolio_diagnostics.benchmark: unchanged ES Three-Engine Intraday Portfolio v1
measurements: daily P&L correlation on all, union-active, and overlapping-active days
descriptive combined P&L, profit factor, and drawdown
portfolio_diagnostics.prohibition: The historical combination cannot be promoted or used to select weights.

decision_policy.forward_paper_tracking: continue only if mechanism, execution, and diversification diagnostics are directionally supportive

result_summary.mechanism: partially supported; the exact scar beat all controls in both samples, but prior VWAP and terminal-price controls were also profitable
result_summary.direction: supported; equal-risk flipped direction lost in development and secondary holdout
result_summary.execution: tick-grid stops survived, but five- and fifteen-minute delays failed holdout
result_summary.tail: failed; top-five removal was negative and cost-stressed bootstrap loss probabilities were high
result_summary.diversification: weak; 92.4 percent same-day overlap and 0.691 holdout daily correlation with the opening-center engine
result_summary.decision: continue unchanged prospective paper tracking only; do not deploy or add historically to the portfolio
